latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Text Maker — turn any text into MP4 videos quickly.

- Instantly generates 30-second videos with visuals and background music from written prompts or uploaded files (TXT, DOCX, PDF, up to 500MB).
- No video editing skills required; describe your idea and receive a downloadable MP4 in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic setup with free credits: connects to cloud GPU video processing using a provided or auto-generated token.
- Supports balance/credits check, session state queries, and streamlined export/download actions.
- Error handling includes credit warnings, file restrictions, and troubleshooting guidance for common issues.
